lamps.name: sun
lamps._: [F] round 2b (fit3.py E, frames 0+420+470): warm lamp under the core, deep (87 mm) and directional (radiance ~ cos^40 of the emission angle: a beam). r1/r2 had it Lambertian 1 mm under the paper; its a^-4 tail lit the paper 50-70 mm away warm (frame 420 rows 90-140).

lamps.name: sky
lamps._: [F] round 2b: broad cool light further back (28 mm deep, radius 36 mm), directional (cos^39). Its edge sets where the steel-blue plateau ends (original: +0.30-0.45 H, then the floor).
lamps._cos_power: [F] radiance ~ cos^n of the emission angle (optics.disc_irradiance_cosn); n = 0 is a Lambertian disc

lamps.name: ambient
lamps._: [F] round 2 / 2b: diffuse cool back-light larger than the field (uniform irradiance), transmitted by the same KM sheet as the lamps: the dark navy floor of shot 38 (original (15,19,23), bt709 tv). Refit jointly in 2b (fit3.py) after the paper texture fix: r2's 0.0076 was partly paying for the clamped thin edge row of the grammage map.

front._: [F] dim fill on the camera side

camera._: [F] to the arc (apex, R/W) of frame 0; f_px and pitch refitted in round 2b (fit.py --stage geo) after the light changed the measured R/W from 3.35 to 3.09 (6777 -> 7107 px, -0.064 -> -0.039 deg)

veil._: [F] round 2b two-part lens veil (optics.veil): halo 12.6 % at sigma 0.084 W; uniform veil fitted to 0 (held-out 485 shows no veil above the band). Replaces r1's single wide Gaussian (0.149 at 0.2 W).

sheen._: [F] scale: radiance of the dim surroundings in front of the sheet, mirrored by the pool's smooth surface (optics.render, Fresnel at the view angle); what lights the opaque ink core in 2b. n 1.333 [A] (pool taken as still wet), neutral 6500 K [A], only the thick ink film is glossy [A] (film_gsm).
sheen._film_gsm: [A] carbon load (g/m^2) above which the ink surface counts as a continuous glossy film; gloss = clip(carbon / film_gsm, 0, 1). The core holds ~45 g/m^2, the halo < 2 at 4 mm out.
